title: 第1课 · 九月去北京旅游最好
subtitle: HSK 2 · Lesson 1 — 九月去北京旅游最好 · September is the best time to visit Beijing

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在学校 — In the school

items.zh: A：我要去北京旅游，你觉得什么时候去最好？
items.py: A: Wǒ yào qù Běijīng lǚyóu, nǐ juéde shénme shíhou qù zuì hǎo?
items.en: A: I'm thinking of a trip to Beijing. When do you think is the best time?

items.py: B: Jiǔ yuè qù Běijīng lǚyóu zuì hǎo.
items.en: B: September is the best time to visit Beijing.
A: Why?

items.zh: B：九月的北京天气不冷也不热。
items.py: B: Jiǔ yuè de Běijīng tiānqì bù lěng yě bú rè.
items.en: B: Because it's neither cold nor hot in September.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 看照片 — Looking at a picture

items.en: A: What sport do you like?

items.py: B: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan tī zúqiú.
items.en: B: I like playing football most.

items.zh: A：下午我们一起去踢足球吧。
items.py: A: Xiàwǔ wǒmen yìqǐ qù tī zúqiú ba.
items.en: A: Let's go and play football this afternoon.
B: Great!

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在家里 — At home

items.zh: A：我们要不要买几个新的椅子？
items.py: A: Wǒmen yào bu yào mǎi jǐ ge xīn de yǐzi?
items.en: A: Shall we buy some new chairs?

items.py: B: Hǎo a. Shénme shíhou qù mǎi?
items.en: B: Yes. When shall we go and buy them?

items.zh: A：明天下午怎么样？你明天几点能回来？
items.py: A: Míngtiān xiàwǔ zěnmeyàng? Nǐ míngtiān jǐ diǎn néng huílai?
items.en: A: What about tomorrow afternoon? When can you be back tomorrow?
B: A bit after three.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 在家里 — At home

items.py: A: Zhuōzi xiàmiàn yǒu ge māo.
items.en: A: There is a cat under the table.

items.py: B: Nà shì wǒ de māo, tā jiào Huāhua.
items.en: B: That's my cat, it's called Huahua.
A: It's beautiful.

items.zh: B：是啊，我觉得它的眼睛最漂亮。
items.py: B: Shì a, wǒ juéde tā de yǎnjing zuì piàoliang.
items.en: B: Yes, I think its eyes are the most beautiful.
A: How old is it?
B: A bit over six months.
